name: AR Video (autoregressive block sampler)
plain: Denoises a video one block of frames at a time using a model with key-value caches, in the style of Causal Forcing and Self-Forcing. Each sub-step jumps to x0 and re-noises on the flow line with fresh noise, then a final call at σ=0 writes the block into the cache. It refuses to run on models without the cache API.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
Block b frames; for each σ_i: D=model(block,σ_i). If σ'=0: block←D. Else fresh ε seeded by torch.manual_seed(seed+1000·b+i); block←(1−σ')D+σ'ε; rewind cache end by frames·seq_len.
After block: output frames←block; rewind cache; one more model call at σ=0.
I2V: an initial latent from transformer_options ar_config is fed at σ=0 first.

props.stages: N+1 per block (N=len(sigmas)−1), plus 1 for I2V seed
props.final_sigma0: σ'=0 returns D for the block; a σ=0 call is always made per block to update the cache.
props.flow_const: Assumes flow: re-noise uses (1−σ')D+σ'ε with no model_sampling lookup; noise_scale is ignored. Requires 5-D latents and init_kv_caches, init_crossattn_caches; raises otherwise.
